title: GPUs
description: Are the GPUs doing the transcoding, and are they healthy?

panels.title: GPUs
panels.description: GPUs reporting: NVIDIA GPUs through the NVIDIA GPU exporter, and Intel GPUs on their machine's own i915 driver through the Intel GPU exporter.

targets.expr: count(nvidia_smi_gpu_info{job="gpu", host=~"$host"} or intel_gpu_up{job="intel_gpu", host=~"$host"})

panels.title: Encoder busy
panels.description: The busiest GPU's video encoder (NVENC): transcodes writing video (Tdarr, Plex).

targets.expr: 100 * max(nvidia_smi_utilization_encoder_ratio{job="gpu", host=~"$host"})

panels.title: Decoder busy
panels.description: The busiest GPU's video decoder (NVDEC): transcodes reading video.

targets.expr: 100 * max(nvidia_smi_utilization_decoder_ratio{job="gpu", host=~"$host"})

panels.title: Encoder sessions
panels.description: Video encoding sessions open on all GPUs: one per running hardware transcode.

targets.expr: sum(nvidia_smi_encoder_stats_session_count{job="gpu", host=~"$host"})

panels.title: Hottest GPU
panels.description: The hottest GPU's core temperature: NVIDIA's from nvidia-smi, Intel's from its driver's hardware sensors (hwmon). Orange from 80 °C, red from 85 °C (the alert).

targets.expr: max(nvidia_smi_temperature_gpu{job="gpu", host=~"$host"} or node_hwmon_temp_celsius{host=~"$host"} * on (job, host, chip) group_left node_hwmon_chip_names{chip_name=~"i915|xe", host=~"$host"})

panels.title: Power
panels.description: Power all GPUs draw together: NVIDIA's from nvidia-smi, Intel's from its driver's energy counter (hwmon).

targets.expr: sum(nvidia_smi_power_draw_watts{job="gpu", host=~"$host"} or rate(node_hwmon_energy_joule_total{host=~"$host"}[5m]) * on (job, host, chip) group_left node_hwmon_chip_names{chip_name=~"i915|xe", host=~"$host"})

panels.title: GPUs
panels.description: Each GPU now. GPU: its compute engines (transcode filters, tone mapping). Encoder and decoder: the video engines a hardware transcode uses. Sessions: open encoding sessions.

targets.expr: label_join(max by (host, uuid, name, driver_version) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{job="gpu", host=~"$host"}), "key", "/", "host", "uuid")
max by (key) (label_join(100 * nvidia_smi_utilization_gpu_ratio{job="gpu", host=~"$host"}, "key", "/", "host", "uuid"))
max by (key) (label_join(100 * nvidia_smi_utilization_encoder_ratio{job="gpu", host=~"$host"}, "key", "/", "host", "uuid"))
max by (key) (label_join(100 * nvidia_smi_utilization_decoder_ratio{job="gpu", host=~"$host"}, "key", "/", "host", "uuid"))
max by (key) (label_join(nvidia_smi_encoder_stats_session_count{job="gpu", host=~"$host"}, "key", "/", "host", "uuid"))
max by (key) (label_join(100 * nvidia_smi_memory_used_bytes{job="gpu", host=~"$host"} / nvidia_smi_memory_total_bytes{job="gpu", host=~"$host"}, "key", "/", "host", "uuid"))
max by (key) (label_join(nvidia_smi_memory_total_bytes{job="gpu", host=~"$host"}, "key", "/", "host", "uuid"))
max by (key) (label_join(nvidia_smi_temperature_gpu{job="gpu", host=~"$host"}, "key", "/", "host", "uuid"))
max by (key) (label_join(nvidia_smi_power_draw_watts{job="gpu", host=~"$host"}, "key", "/", "host", "uuid"))

panels.title: Video encoder and decoder
panels.description: How busy each GPU's video engines are: the encoder (NVENC) writes, the decoder (NVDEC) reads. A hardware transcode shows on both.

targets.expr: 100 * nvidia_smi_utilization_encoder_ratio{job="gpu", host=~"$host"} * on (host, uuid) group_left (name, index) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{job="gpu", host=~"$host"}
100 * nvidia_smi_utilization_decoder_ratio{job="gpu", host=~"$host"} * on (host, uuid) group_left (name, index) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{job="gpu", host=~"$host"}

panels.title: GPU and memory controller
panels.description: The GPU's compute engines, and how busy its memory is (not how full).

targets.expr: 100 * nvidia_smi_utilization_gpu_ratio{job="gpu", host=~"$host"} * on (host, uuid) group_left (name, index) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{job="gpu", host=~"$host"}
100 * nvidia_smi_utilization_memory_ratio{job="gpu", host=~"$host"} * on (host, uuid) group_left (name, index) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{job="gpu", host=~"$host"}

panels.title: Encoder sessions
panels.description: Open video encoding sessions per GPU: one per running hardware transcode.

targets.expr: nvidia_smi_encoder_stats_session_count{job="gpu", host=~"$host"} * on (host, uuid) group_left (name, index) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{job="gpu", host=~"$host"}

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: GPU memory in use per GPU (transcodes, and Plex's tone mapping, hold some each).

targets.expr: nvidia_smi_memory_used_bytes{job="gpu", host=~"$host"} * on (host, uuid) group_left (name, index) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{job="gpu", host=~"$host"}

panels.title: Temperature and power
panels.description: Core temperature (°C) and power draw (W) per GPU.

targets.expr: nvidia_smi_temperature_gpu{job="gpu", host=~"$host"} * on (host, uuid) group_left (name, index) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{job="gpu", host=~"$host"}
nvidia_smi_power_draw_watts{job="gpu", host=~"$host"} * on (host, uuid) group_left (name, index) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{job="gpu", host=~"$host"}

panels.title: Intel GPUs
panels.description: Each Intel GPU now, from the Intel GPU exporter (intel_gpu_top), averaged over 5 minutes. Video: the Quick Sync engines that decode and encode a hardware transcode. Render/3D: tone mapping and filters. VideoEnhance: scaling and deinterlacing. A GPU on vfio-pci is passed through to a VM, which reports it under its own name; temperature and power come from the driver's hardware sensors (hwmon).

targets.expr: label_join(max by (host, pci_slot, driver) (intel_gpu_info{job="intel_gpu", host=~"$host"}), "key", "/", "host", "pci_slot")

max by (key) (label_join((max by (host, pci_slot) (intel_gpu_info{job="intel_gpu", host=~"$host"}) + on (host, pci_slot) max by (host, pci_slot) (intel_gpu_up{job="intel_gpu", host=~"$host"})) or max by (host, pci_slot) (intel_gpu_info{job="intel_gpu", host=~"$host"}) * 0, "key", "/", "host", "pci_slot"))
max by (key) (label_join(100 * rate(intel_gpu_engine_busy_seconds_total{job="intel_gpu", host=~"$host", engine="Video"}[5m]), "key", "/", "host", "pci_slot"))
max by (key) (label_join(100 * rate(intel_gpu_engine_busy_seconds_total{job="intel_gpu", host=~"$host", engine="Render/3D"}[5m]), "key", "/", "host", "pci_slot"))
max by (key) (label_join(100 * rate(intel_gpu_engine_busy_seconds_total{job="intel_gpu", host=~"$host", engine="VideoEnhance"}[5m]), "key", "/", "host", "pci_slot"))
max by (key) (label_join(intel_gpu_frequency_hertz{job="intel_gpu", host=~"$host", type="actual"}, "key", "/", "host", "pci_slot"))

max by (key) (label_join(label_replace(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{host=~"$host"} * on (job, host, chip) group_left node_hwmon_chip_names{chip_name=~"i915|xe", host=~"$host"}, "pci_slot", "$1.$2", "chip", ".*([0-9a-f]{4}:[0-9a-f]{2}:[0-9a-f]{2})_([0-9a-f])"), "key", "/", "host", "pci_slot"))

max by (key) (label_join(label_replace(rate(node_hwmon_energy_joule_total{host=~"$host"}[5m]) * on (job, host, chip) group_left node_hwmon_chip_names{chip_name=~"i915|xe", host=~"$host"}, "pci_slot", "$1.$2", "chip", ".*([0-9a-f]{4}:[0-9a-f]{2}:[0-9a-f]{2})_([0-9a-f])"), "key", "/", "host", "pci_slot"))

panels.title: Intel engines
panels.description: How busy each Intel GPU's engines are: Video (Quick Sync decode and encode), Render/3D and VideoEnhance, as the share of each interval they were busy.

targets.expr: 100 * max by (host, pci_slot, engine) (rate(intel_gpu_engine_busy_seconds_total{job="intel_gpu", host=~"$host", engine=~"Render/3D|Video|VideoEnhance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Intel temperature and power
panels.description: Core temperature (°C) and power draw (W) per Intel GPU, from its driver's hardware sensors (hwmon): the server's driver, or a VM's when the card is passed through to it.

targets.expr: max by (host, pci_slot) (label_replace(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{host=~"$host"} * on (job, host, chip) group_left node_hwmon_chip_names{chip_name=~"i915|xe", host=~"$host"}, "pci_slot", "$1.$2", "chip", ".*([0-9a-f]{4}:[0-9a-f]{2}:[0-9a-f]{2})_([0-9a-f])"))

max by (host, pci_slot) (label_replace(rate(node_hwmon_energy_joule_total{host=~"$host"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (job, host, chip) group_left node_hwmon_chip_names{chip_name=~"i915|xe", host=~"$host"}, "pci_slot", "$1.$2", "chip", ".*([0-9a-f]{4}:[0-9a-f]{2}:[0-9a-f]{2})_([0-9a-f])"))
